MatrixOne 4.1.0 · retrieval and versioning in one engine ← section 6 drives this layer directly in SQL
vector + full-text hybrid
store "black formatter", ask "code formatting tool"
relational queries

the Git4Data capability · branching and versions
snapshot (storage-layer CoW, no data copy) · branch (object-granularity clone, carries storage) · diff · merge · rollback
The boundary: confidence, source_run, memory types and conflict rules are Memoria's or your application's policy;
branch / DIFF / merge / snapshot / restore are the underlying capability MatrixOne provides.
The Git4Data capability doesn't decide what deserves remembering — it guarantees the deciding has an isolated area, a record of what changed, and a way back.
